description: The reserved per-widget-class hook is declared but shape-open: the schema constrains presence only (non-empty object), leaving the inner shape to pass 2. Branch-open still refuses any non-empty payload.
note: Schema-valid by design: pinning the inner shape now would freeze pass 2 before it has a consumer, so the schema constrains presence only. The refusal is evaluation-side (`class-scope-deferred`). The sibling `invalid-class-scope-empty-object` covers the one payload the schema does reject.
